issue.title: Walker-footer e2e geometryStable fails: the [[ s w n b ]] selector x shifts with each family's panel width
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-oj.6 (note #3) and bob-cli-oj.7 (note #3), and corroborated on clean master fc806cf by the bob-cli-oj.5.1 land agent. The bob-cli-oj land agent triaged it.

## What fails

`scripts/obsidian-walker-footer-e2e.cjs` (real Obsidian under xvfb, 1400x900) fails only `geometryStable`. All group, panel, dot, ink, and bank checks pass. The check asserts that the `.bob-bracket-mode` selector rect is identical across the s/w/n/b families, both immediately and after settling:
`sameRect(rectS, rectW) && sameRect(rectW, rectN) && sameRect(rectN, rectB) && ...` (`scripts/obsidian-walker-footer-e2e.cjs` around line 663).

Observed selector x positions:
- bob-cli-oj.6/.7 (post-7b44b29): s 819, w 956, n 1085, b 968. Width and height are stable at 30 px.
- bob-cli-oj.land at **9a15d52** (before the bob-cli-oj.6 footer change): rectS x 443.4 vs rectN x 709.6. Width (102.6) and height (30) are identical.

So the failure predates bob-cli-oj and was not caused by the group-arms footer.

## Root cause

Obsidian's status bar is right-anchored, and `.bob-bracket-mode` (the `[[ s w n b ]]` selector) sits to the left of the walker footer panel. Its x is the bar's right edge minus the widths of everything after it, and those widths differ per family. Only x moves; y, width, and height stay put.

## Next step

Decide the contract. Either keep the selector still across families, for example by placing it to the right of the panel or giving the panel a stable slot, or relax the e2e to compare y/width/height and the selector's distance from its own right neighbour. Then make the e2e and the walker-footer docs agree. `scripts/obsidian-walker-footer-e2e.cjs` was introduced by bob-cli-ky (3ef045b).

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic: identical selector x offsets across reruns by bob-cli-oj.6, bob-cli-oj.7, and bob-cli-oj.5.1.land (s 819 / w 956 / n 1085 / b 968 at 1400x900), and the same kind of offset at pre-epic 9a15d52 (s 443 vs n 710). The offset follows layout arithmetic (a right-anchored status bar), not timing.

issue.creation_reason: Three bob-cli-oj phases and its land agent hit this real-Obsidian e2e failure; no task tracked it, and the lander proved it predates the epic (fails at 9a15d52).
